title: Meter Reading Work Order Form
subtitle: An original meter reading workflow that controls authorized field work from dispatch through return to service, with explicit qualified-review, stop-work, escalation, and accountable handoff controls.
description: A workflow-complete meter reading work order form for the utility meter and register that captures exact identity, domain observations, supporting evidence, decisions, exceptions, responsible owners, and closeout without replacing professional judgment or the organization's controlling procedures.
use_case: Use when a qualified crew receives a defined task and must preserve asset identity, work limits, energy-control references, as-found evidence, work performed, testing, exceptions, and operations handoff. The meter operations lead owns routing, and closure requires documented evidence, disposition of restrictions, and acceptance by the designated reviewer.

sections.title: Meter reading work order identity and dispatch
sections.guidance: Issue a traceable order with clear ownership, site contacts, and approved work limits.

sections.title: Meter reading asset context, scope, and resources
sections.guidance: Match the order to the exact utility meter and register and define work that is included and excluded.

blocks.label: Authorized task scope
items: Verify route, account, premise, commodity, and meter identity
Assess access and stop conditions before approaching the meter
Capture register, unit, multiplier, decimal, and flow direction
Record date, time, method, operator, and evidence reference
Compare against prior accepted read and expected use pattern
Recheck transcription and photograph when variance is material
Document access failure, obstruction, display, seal, or device issue
Route suspected leak, electrical, gas, tamper, or safety condition
Submit accepted reading or hold with a named review owner
Schedule reread, service investigation, or customer follow-up

blocks.label: Scope, exclusions, parts, and completion criteria

fields.label: Approved work, explicit exclusions, required parts or tools, evidence expected, and completion criteria

sections.title: Meter reading pre-work controls and authorization
sections.guidance: Do not begin intrusive work until hazards, system effects, isolation ownership, and test authority are explicit.

blocks.label: Pre-work authorization confirmations
items: Exact asset, boundaries, sources, and affected systems were identified
Site-specific procedure and applicable requirements were reviewed
Authorized and affected people, roles, and communications were confirmed
Electrical, mechanical, pressure, thermal, chemical, gravity, and stored energy were assessed
Isolation devices and personal or group controls remain under designated ownership
Stored or residual energy was controlled and verification evidence was recorded
Test or temporary re-energization steps and authority are explicit
Public, customer, traffic, environmental, and critical-load controls are in place

blocks.label: Energy-control and qualified-person boundary
blocks.guidance: A reading record does not authorize opening, bypassing, adjusting, or repairing a meter or related service equipment. Stop for gas odor, exposed electrical parts, water near energized equipment, flooding, animals, traffic, or unsafe access. Withdraw, keep others clear, and route the condition to qualified utility or emergency personnel under current site procedures. This work order records references and decisions; it does not replace the site's energy-control procedure. Unknown, changed, or reaccumulating energy is a stop condition until the designated authorized person re-establishes and verifies control.

sections.title: Meter reading work execution and test evidence
sections.guidance: Record what was actually done, by whom, against which task, and with what result.

blocks.label: As-left readings and test results
blocks.guidance: Record method, instrument, operating state, and acceptance reference in linked evidence when needed.

fields.label: Unexpected conditions, approved changes, temporary measures, test context, and evidence links

sections.title: Meter reading exceptions, stop conditions, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make every unresolved condition visible with an immediate control, owner, due point, and final disposition.

blocks.label: Stop-condition screen
items: Gas odor, hissing, damaged regulator, or suspected leak
Exposed conductor, arcing, heat, burn mark, or damaged electric enclosure
Flooding, standing water, active leak, ice, or unstable walking surface
Aggressive animal, insect nest, traffic, excavation, or restricted access
Broken seal or enclosure requiring opening or equipment manipulation
Unknown meter identity, cross-connection, or unsafe customer equipment
Weather or site condition prevents a safe, reliable observation
Any work beyond a normal-interface read and assigned authorization
blocks.guidance: Check any condition observed or reported; checking an item does not mean the condition is controlled.

blocks.label: Qualified-person and stop-work boundary
blocks.guidance: A reading record does not authorize opening, bypassing, adjusting, or repairing a meter or related service equipment. Stop for gas odor, exposed electrical parts, water near energized equipment, flooding, animals, traffic, or unsafe access. Withdraw, keep others clear, and route the condition to qualified utility or emergency personnel under current site procedures.

blocks.label: Exception and escalation register
blocks.guidance: Link each work order exception to supporting evidence and keep it open until disposition is recorded.

sections.title: Meter reading decision, handoff, and accountable closeout
sections.guidance: Record the decision, remaining limitations, next action, and the people accountable for acceptance.

blocks.label: Closeout completeness
items: Utility meter and register identity and location were reconciled
Observed facts, measurements, and evidence references are complete
Decision authority and applicable review requirements were confirmed
Stop conditions, restrictions, and open exceptions remain visible
Customer, operations, or site handoff was recorded
Next action, owner, due point, and record-retention route are explicit

fields.label: Limitations, assumptions, restrictions, customer message, and next-action context

blocks.label: Accountable review and handoff
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and handoff; they do not waive unresolved restrictions.
